caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular panel with a repetitive, symmetrical pattern set against a pale, light beige background. Along the top edge, there is a decorative border featuring three brownish-red swags with hanging tassels, reminiscent of draped fabric, and a row of small brownish dots above them. On the main body of the panel, there are three vertical columns of floral motifs. The left column consists of four sun-like flowers with a brown center and red, radiating petals. The center column contains a vertical row of smaller, brown, ornate symmetrical shapes reminiscent of stylized plant stems or vines. The right column alternates between two different types of flower motifs: one with a red center and brown petals/leaves radiating outward, and one made up of only brown, thin, swirling petals. Faint leafy sprigs appear near some of the flowers, also in brown. The entire panel is bordered by a light yellow-beige frame featuring a subtle repetitive dot and dash pattern. The predominant colors throughout the image are muted reds, browns, and beige tones.
title: Stencilled Wall
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
